readings: Group sentiment and fundamentals snapshots by corpeventprx, treating NULL as its own group. For each group, return the event type, the average anlycount, and the average of inholdpct − instownpct calculated per snapshot. Subtract the unweighted average of all groups’ average differences, including the NULL event-type group. Ignore missing values in each average, preserve negative results, and do not round. Return no rows if the unweighted average is missing.

Group sentiment and fundamentals snapshots by corpeventprx, treating NULL as its own group. For each group, return the event type, the average anlycount, and the average of inholdpct − instownpct calculated per snapshot. Subtract the unweighted average of the average differences for non-NULL event types only. Ignore missing values in each average, preserve negative results, and do not round. Return no rows if the unweighted average is missing.
queries:
WITH event_groups AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_difference
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS unweighted_avg_difference
  FROM event_groups
)
SELECT
  event_groups.corpeventprx,
  event_groups.avg_anlycount,
  event_groups.avg_difference - overall.unweighted_avg_difference AS adjusted_difference
FROM event_groups
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE overall.unweighted_avg_difference IS NOT NULL

WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT
        corpeventprx,
        AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
        AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_difference
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_difference) AS unweighted_avg_difference
    FROM event_averages
    WHERE corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    e.corpeventprx,
    e.avg_anlycount,
    e.avg_difference - b.unweighted_avg_difference AS adjusted_avg_difference
FROM event_averages AS e
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.unweighted_avg_difference IS NOT NULL
